request.description: DELETE /users/{id}/AdamYahya. Security Administrator only. Returns 200, or 403 for other roles. Implemented by: Adam Yahya
GET /users/nobody/AdamYahya with the admin token. Returns 404 “User not found”. Implemented by: Adam Yahya
PUT /users/{id}/AdamYahya. Updates full_name, email or department. Admin may update anyone; a Regular User only themselves (403 otherwise). Implemented by: Adam Yahya

POST /assets/AdamYahya. Creates a new asset (a High criticality Server). Only a Security Administrator may create assets. Required: asset_name, asset_type, ip_address, department, owner_id, criticality_level. Returns 201 with the new asset. Implemented by: Adam Yahya
POST /assets/AdamYahya. Creates a new asset (a Critical Database). Security Administrator only. Returns 201 with the new asset. Implemented by: Adam Yahya
POST /assets/AdamYahya. Creates a new asset (a Medium criticality Workstation). Security Administrator only. Returns 201 with the new asset. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

POST /assets/AdamYahya. Creates a new asset (a Network Device with status Under Maintenance). Optional fields such as operating_system are left out and stored as null. Security Administrator only. Returns 201. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

POST /assets/AdamYahya. Creates a new asset (a Low criticality Cloud Resource). Optional fields location and operating_system are left out. Security Administrator only. Returns 201. Implemented by: Adam Yahya
POST /assets/AdamYahya. Validation test: the ip_address 999.1.1.1 is not a valid IP address, so the asset is rejected with 400 and a clear message. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

POST /assets/AdamYahya. Validation test: the asset_type Toaster is not one of the allowed types (Server, Workstation, Database, Application, Network Device, Cloud Resource), so the request is rejected with 400. Implemented by: Adam Yahya
POST /assets/AdamYahya. Authentication test: the request is sent with no Authorization header, so it is rejected with 401 (Authentication required). Implemented by: Adam Yahya

POST /assets/AdamYahya. Authorization test: a Regular User token is valid but this role has no access to asset APIs, so the request is rejected with 403. The violation is written to the audit log. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

PUT /assets/{id}/AdamYahya. Updates asset_name, owner_id, department, criticality_level and/or status of an existing asset. Security Administrator only. The new owner must be an existing user. Returns 200 with the updated asset. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

GET /assets/{id}/AdamYahya. Returns one asset by id, including its owner name and its related_incidents and related_vulnerabilities lists. Allowed for Security Administrator, Security Analyst and Auditor. Used here to show the asset after the update. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

GET /assets/AdamYahya. Returns every registered asset with its details, criticality level and status. Allowed for Security Administrator and Auditor only (an Analyst gets 403). Implemented by: Adam Yahya
GET /assets/{id}/AdamYahya. Error test: asset 9999 does not exist, so the service returns 404 with the message Asset not found. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

GET /assets/search/AdamYahya?asset_name=... Searches assets by name. The text can match part of the name and is not case sensitive. Allowed for Security Administrator, Security Analyst and Auditor. Implemented by: Adam Yahya
GET /assets/search/AdamYahya?asset_type=... Searches assets by exact asset type (for example Database). Allowed for Security Administrator, Security Analyst and Auditor. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

GET /assets/search/AdamYahya?ip_address=... Searches assets by exact IP address. The address is validated first. Allowed for Security Administrator, Security Analyst and Auditor. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

GET /assets/search/AdamYahya?department=... Searches assets by department. The text can match part of the department name. Allowed for Security Administrator, Security Analyst and Auditor. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

GET /assets/search/AdamYahya?criticality_level=... Searches assets by exact criticality level (Low, Medium, High or Critical). Allowed for Security Administrator, Security Analyst and Auditor. Implemented by: Adam Yahya

DELETE /assets/{id}/AdamYahya. Removes an asset. Security Administrator only: any other role gets 403 and the attempt is logged. Returns 200 on success, 404 if the asset does not exist, and 409 if incidents or vulnerabilities still reference it. Implemented by: Adam Yahya
